flashcard_questions.q: Actions or intentions that are morally right, promote well-being and align with God's will.
Actions or intentions that are morally wrong, cause harm and go against God's will.
The God-given ability to make choices freely, including the choice between good and evil.

flashcard_questions.a: A person entrusted with looking after something; in Islam, humans are stewards of God's creation.
Charitable giving in Islam, one of the Five Pillars, requiring Muslims to share their wealth with those in need.
